hints: The note comes from `client/src/components/WeekGrid.tsx`, which asks `insideHours(hours, weekday, time)` for each appointment. Read the condition it uses to decide that a time is inside a period.

A period is a half-open range: an appointment of 30 minutes can start at `startsAt` and must start before `endsAt`. The condition is written the other way round: `time > startsAt` leaves out the first slot, and `time <= endsAt` takes in the end.
Write the range as the clinic means it: `time >= period.startsAt && time < period.endsAt`. The times are texts `HH:MM`, which compare in the order of the clock.
